answer.book: Petrus Allinga, Fax dissidii extincta, sive Exercitationes pacificae (Amsterdam 1682): one polemical Latin work with an address to the reader and 89 numbered chapters (Caput I to LXXXIX), each opening with a heading that names a question taken from Leydekker, followed by a closing conclusion.
